purpose: Training-stage ablation for the one-to-one NMS-free head. All values use the same 192-image validation split unless noted.

stages.name: stage1_base
stages.description: 40 epochs, o2o loss weight 1.0, no duplicate-suppression term

stages.name: stage2_stronger_o2o
stages.description: 20 fine-tune epochs, o2o loss weight 2.5, no duplicate-suppression term

stages.name: stage3_strong_neighbor_penalty
stages.description: 15 fine-tune epochs, hard-negative weight 1.5; too strong and collapsed recall

stages.name: stage3_soft_neighbor_penalty_final
stages.description: 10 fine-tune epochs, o2o loss weight 2.5, hard-negative weight 0.1; final model

note: Stage3 strong-neighbor is retained as a documented failure case, not as the final model. The final model uses the soft-neighbor stage.
